description: A FastAPI-based server that acts as a wrapper for the Braintrust API, transforming prompt responses into a format compatible with LiteLLM. It includes endpoints for fetching prompts, health checks, and server startup logic.

methods.name: transform_braintrust_message
methods.description: Transforms a Braintrust message dict into LiteLLM format, including optional 'name' field.

methods.name: transform_braintrust_response
methods.description: Transforms Braintrust API response into LiteLLM prompt management format, extracting messages, model, and optional parameters.

methods.name: get_prompt
methods.description: API endpoint to fetch a prompt from Braintrust, transform it, and return in LiteLLM format.

methods.name: health_check
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning service status.

methods.name: root
methods.description: Root endpoint providing service info and endpoints.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Starts the server with configurable host and port.
